rows.en: Acknowledgements
rows.ne: आभार
rows.bt: Acknowledgements

rows.en: The MHPSS Minimum Service Package was developed by the IASC Reference Group for Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Emergency Settings (IASC MHPSS RG).
rows.ne: MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज आपत्कालीन परिस्थितिमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगसम्बन्धी IASC सन्दर्भ समूह (IASC MHPSS RG) ले विकास गरेको हो।
rows.bt: The MHPSS minimum service package was developed by the IASC Reference Group on Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Emergency Settings (IASC MHPSS RG).
rows.note: Uses cited unreviewed clinical candidate T001 in the group name. Reuses the proposal आपत्कालीन परिस्थिति for emergency settings without changing the frozen glossary.

rows.en: The development of the package and the coordination of the field demonstration, reviews, and editing was led by the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) and the World Health Organization (WHO) in collaboration with the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) and the United Nations Populations Fund (UNFPA).
rows.ne: United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) र विश्व स्वास्थ्य सङ्गठन (WHO) ले United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) र United Nations Populations Fund (UNFPA) सँगको सहकार्यमा प्याकेजको विकास तथा स्थलगत प्रदर्शन, समीक्षा र सम्पादनको समन्वयको नेतृत्व गरेका थिए।
rows.bt: United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) and the World Health Organization (WHO), in collaboration with United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) and United Nations Populations Fund (UNFPA), led the coordination of the package’s development and field demonstration, review and editing.
rows.note: Institutional names without supplied candidates are retained in English, including the source wording United Nations Populations Fund.

rows.en: These processes were supported by a thematic working group of member agencies of the Reference Group, including Act Church of Sweden, IFRC Psychosocial Centre, the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC), International Association of Schools of Social Work, International Medical Corps (IMC), International Rescue Committee (IRC), International Organization for Migration (IOM), Jesuit Refugee Services (JRS), Medair, MHPSS.net, Norwegian Church Aid (NCA), Save the Children, HealthNet TPO, Transcultural Psychosocial Organization Nepal (TPO Nepal), and World Vision International (WVI).
rows.ne: यी प्रक्रियाहरूमा सन्दर्भ समूहका सदस्य निकायहरूको विषयगत कार्यसमूहले सहयोग गरेको थियो। उक्त समूहमा Act Church of Sweden, IFRC Psychosocial Centre, International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC), International Association of Schools of Social Work, International Medical Corps (IMC), International Rescue Committee (IRC), International Organization for Migration (IOM), Jesuit Refugee Services (JRS), Medair, MHPSS.net, Norwegian Church Aid (NCA), Save the Children, HealthNet TPO, Transcultural Psychosocial Organization Nepal (TPO Nepal) र World Vision International (WVI) समावेश थिए।
rows.bt: These processes were supported by a thematic working group of the Reference Group’s member agencies. The group included Act Church of Sweden, IFRC Psychosocial Centre, International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC), International Association of Schools of Social Work, International Medical Corps (IMC), International Rescue Committee (IRC), International Organization for Migration (IOM), Jesuit Refugee Services (JRS), Medair, MHPSS.net, Norwegian Church Aid (NCA), Save the Children, HealthNet TPO, Transcultural Psychosocial Organization Nepal (TPO Nepal) and World Vision International (WVI).
rows.note: All named member agencies and their supplied acronyms are retained in English; no new clinical wording is introduced through institutional names.

rows.en: Through consultations, discussions, surveys, interviews, and reviews, feedback was also received from key stakeholders in global, regional, and frontline positions including contributors from Action Contre la Faim (ACF), Americares, CBM Global, Child Protection Area of Responsibility (CP AoR), Christian Aid, Colombian Red Cross, Creative Associates International, Dan Church Aid (DCA), FHI 360, Finn Church Aid (FCA), Gender-based Violence Area of Responsibility (GBV AoR), Global Camp Coordination and Camp Management Cluster (CCCM), Global Education Cluster, Global Food Security Cluster, Global Health Cluster, Global Protection Cluster, Global Shelter Cluster, Global Water, Sanitation and Hygiene Cluster (WASH), HIAS, Inter-agency Network for Education in Emergencies (INEE), London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM), McGill University, Médecins du Monde (MdM), Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF), MHPSS Collaborative, Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC), the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), Porticus, Plan International, Regional Psychosocial Support Initiative (REPSSI), Right to Play, SOS Children’s Villages International, Terre des Hommes (TdH), The Alliance for Child Protection in Humanitarian Action, United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS), War Child Holland, War Child UK, as well as many country-level Technical Working Groups, individual practitioners, experts, academic partners and government representatives.
rows.ne: परामर्श, छलफल, सर्वेक्षण, अन्तर्वार्ता तथा समीक्षामार्फत विश्वव्यापी, क्षेत्रीय तथा अग्रपङ्क्तिका भूमिकामा रहेका प्रमुख सरोकारवालाहरूबाट पनि प्रतिक्रिया प्राप्त भयो। यसमा Action Contre la Faim (ACF), Americares, CBM Global, बाल संरक्षण जिम्मेवारी क्षेत्र (Child Protection Area of Responsibility, CP AoR), Christian Aid, Colombian Red Cross, Creative Associates International, Dan Church Aid (DCA), FHI 360, Finn Church Aid (FCA), लैङ्गिक हिंसा जिम्मेवारी क्षेत्र (Gender-based Violence Area of Responsibility, GBV AoR), विश्वव्यापी शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन क्लस्टर (Global Camp Coordination and Camp Management Cluster, CCCM), विश्वव्यापी शिक्षा क्लस्टर (Global Education Cluster), विश्वव्यापी खाद्य सुरक्षा क्लस्टर (Global Food Security Cluster), विश्वव्यापी स्वास्थ्य क्लस्टर (Global Health Cluster), विश्वव्यापी संरक्षण क्लस्टर (Global Protection Cluster), Global Shelter Cluster, विश्वव्यापी खानेपानी, सरसफाइ तथा स्वच्छता क्लस्टर (Global Water, Sanitation and Hygiene Cluster, WASH), HIAS, Inter-agency Network for Education in Emergencies (INEE), London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM), McGill University, Médecins du Monde (MdM), Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF), MHPSS Collaborative, Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC), Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), Porticus, Plan International, Regional Psychosocial Support Initiative (REPSSI), Right to Play, SOS Children’s Villages International, Terre des Hommes (TdH), The Alliance for Child Protection in Humanitarian Action, United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS), War Child Holland र War Child UK का योगदानकर्ताहरूका साथै देशस्तरका धेरै प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (Technical Working Groups), व्यक्तिगत रूपमा कार्यरत अभ्यासकर्ता, विज्ञ, प्राज्ञिक साझेदार र सरकारी प्रतिनिधिहरू समावेश थिए।
rows.bt: Feedback was also received from key stakeholders in global, regional and frontline roles through consultations, discussions, surveys, interviews and reviews. These included contributors from Action Contre la Faim (ACF), Americares, CBM Global, the Child Protection Area of Responsibility (CP AoR), Christian Aid, Colombian Red Cross, Creative Associates International, Dan Church Aid (DCA), FHI 360, Finn Church Aid (FCA), the Gender-based Violence Area of Responsibility (GBV AoR), the Global Camp Coordination and Camp Management Cluster (CCCM), the Global Education Cluster, the Global Food Security Cluster, the Global Health Cluster, the Global Protection Cluster, Global Shelter Cluster, the Global Water, Sanitation and Hygiene Cluster (WASH), HIAS, Inter-agency Network for Education in Emergencies (INEE), London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM), McGill University, Médecins du Monde (MdM), Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF), MHPSS Collaborative, Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC), Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), Porticus, Plan International, Regional Psychosocial Support Initiative (REPSSI), Right to Play, SOS Children’s Villages International, Terre des Hommes (TdH), The Alliance for Child Protection in Humanitarian Action, United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS), War Child Holland and War Child UK, as well as many country-level Technical Working Groups, practitioners working individually, experts, academic partners and government representatives.
rows.note: Institutional names without supplied Nepali forms are retained in English. Translated sector and coordination labels use the supplied unreviewed candidates; embedded institutional names are not newly translated as clinical terminology.

rows.en: In addition, critical insights were gathered throughout the one-year field-testing period in multiple demonstration countries, which was implemented through partnerships with the following agencies: Better World Organization (BWO), Grow Strong Foundation (GSF), HealthNet TPO South Sudan (TPO South Sudan), Médecins du Monde Ukraine (MdM Ukraine), Fundación Proinco, HealthNet TPO Nigeria (TPO Nigeria), War Child Holland (WCH), World Vision Colombia.
rows.ne: यसका अतिरिक्त, नमुना कार्यान्वयन गरिएका विभिन्न देशहरूमा एक वर्षको स्थलगत परीक्षण अवधिभर महत्त्वपूर्ण अन्तर्दृष्टिहरू सङ्कलन गरिए। उक्त परीक्षण निम्न निकायहरूसँगको साझेदारीमार्फत कार्यान्वयन गरिएको थियो: Better World Organization (BWO), Grow Strong Foundation (GSF), HealthNet TPO South Sudan (TPO South Sudan), Médecins du Monde Ukraine (MdM Ukraine), Fundación Proinco, HealthNet TPO Nigeria (TPO Nigeria), War Child Holland (WCH) र World Vision Colombia।
rows.bt: In addition, important insights were collected throughout a one-year field-testing period in various countries where pilot implementation was carried out. That testing was implemented through partnerships with the following bodies: Better World Organization (BWO), Grow Strong Foundation (GSF), HealthNet TPO South Sudan (TPO South Sudan), Médecins du Monde Ukraine (MdM Ukraine), Fundación Proinco, HealthNet TPO Nigeria (TPO Nigeria), War Child Holland (WCH) and World Vision Colombia.
rows.note: The one-year duration, multiple demonstration-country setting and all eight partner agencies are retained. Institutional names and acronyms remain in their source forms.

rows.en: The development of the MSP was funded by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands, the United Kingdom Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office, Education Cannot Wait, and the Global Protection Cluster.
rows.ne: MSP को विकासका लागि नेदरल्यान्ड्सको परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालय, संयुक्त अधिराज्यको विदेश, राष्ट्रमण्डल तथा विकास कार्यालय, Education Cannot Wait र विश्वव्यापी संरक्षण क्लस्टर (Global Protection Cluster) ले आर्थिक सहयोग प्रदान गरेका थिए।
rows.bt: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands, the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office of the United Kingdom, Education Cannot Wait and the Global Protection Cluster had provided financial support for the development of the MSP.
rows.note: All four funding bodies are retained. Education Cannot Wait remains an institutional name rather than being translated as a statement.
